jordan: Heads up — saw two OOMs in prod-gpu-pool-3 between 01:02-01:04 UTC, both tied to long chat contexts (~12k tokens) with KV reuse + mixed-kernel selection enabled. stack looks like kv_alloc -> grow_slab -> cudaMalloc OOM.

maya: ugh. any recent rollouts?

jordan: rolled kernel-selection v2 yesterday (prefer fast_fwd kernels for short seqs, mixed for long). also enabled aggressive kv_reuse heuristic for 1.2.0.

liam: can you paste the OOM log snippet?

jordan: sure, TL;DR from node-42: ```
E CudaOOM: out of memory when allocating 1.3GiB
  at kv_cache::slab_grow (slabmap.rs:412)
  at kv_cache::alloc_prefix (kvcache.rs:128)
  at runtime::serve_token (serve.rs:910)
```

sophie: interesting — mixed kernels increase temporary workspace for some attention kernels, depending on quantization path. might be inflating peak by ~20-30% for long ctx. perf-bot: I posted a profiling capture.

perf-bot: link: https://s3.redwood-internal/profiles/1952356789/kv-mixed-kernel-flame.html (flamegraph shows peak memory from attention-workspace and kv slab growth overlapping)

maya: immediate mitigation options? can we fallback kernel-selection to conservative for that pool? or disable kv_reuse for >8k contexts?

jordan: I tested a hotfix on staging: set env KV_REUSE_MAX_CONTEXT=8192 and KERNEL_POLICY=conservative -> no OOMs on long replay tests.

liam: sounds good. ops: can we apply safe rollback to prod-gpu-pool-3? what about perf impact?

sophie: fallback to conservative kernels costs ~8-12% latency on short requests (measured), but avoids 1.3GiB spike. kv_reuse cap removes reuse for very long prefixes which increases token compute slightly but reduces slab churn. overall cost delta ~+6%.

katie: @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary with those env overrides on 3 nodes in prod-gpu-pool-3? include traffic split 5% and auto-rollback on OOM/error >1 per min.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: pool=prod-gpu-pool-3 nodes=3 split=5% rollout=manual_autoscale env:{KV_REUSE_MAX_CONTEXT=8192,KERNEL_POLICY=conservative} healthchecks=inflight_errors<1/min. Start ETA 05:10 UTC.

maya: also add a temporary emergency metric: kv_slab_alloc_failures and kv_reuse_skips — want alerts if either >0 for canary.

jordan: added alert rules to canary oncall.

liam: long-term we should: (1) make kernel selection aware of slab/peak workspace cost in optimizer, (2) add a compaction path for slabmap to reclaim fragments during long contexts, (3) adjust batching heuristic to avoid building huge combined workspaces when many long sessions are collocated.

sophie: Agreed. I can prototype kernel-cost model next sprint — need perf traces across quant modes. perf-bot: queueing job to run synthetic longctx matrix with mixed kernels off/on.

perf-bot: queued job id=pb-1952356790, expect results in 2h.

jordan: created incident #INC-2026-472 (ops) to track the rollout + followups. tagging this thread.

liam: thanks — once canary stabilizes, let's plan a full rollout with the safe env flags and schedule kernel-cost modeling work.

katie: noted, I'll monitor alerts and hold on escalation. :thumbsup:

jordan: quick note for postmortem: include perf delta table (latency, p50/p95), mem-peak numbers, and what triggered reuse heuristic for those conversations.

maya: copying in eng-sre for visibility.

jordan: closing loop here, will update incident and add repro steps for the allocator case (small program + seq gen) in the ticket.

deploy-bot: canary started at 05:10 UTC on nodes [n-210,n-211,n-212].
